column1: # C3 Task 10: two-layer Baltic climatology (surface thetao nan-mean / CMEMS bottomT),
# replacing the 15.0 compatibility placeholder from Task 7. species.zlayer.sp{i} in
# baltic_ev_param-bioen.csv selects layer per species (cod, flounder -> bottom
# rest -> surface), matching the design spec's global species/layer assignment.
# forcing/baltic_temperature_2layer_climatology.nc under this config dir is a symlink to
# shares production data/baltic's forcing product rather than an independent copy, so the
# two never drift out of sync (F2, final-branch-review.md 2026-09-05: this key used to read
# a bare "forcing/..." path with no forcing/ dir here at all, resolving only by accident
# through resolve_data_path's data/*/ glob fallback -- order-dependent on untracked local
# dirs and silently wrong if another data/*/forcing/ carried a same-named file).
